# `silk/build/delegate`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

A build graph as a task program hands it to the compiler, and the compiler's answer.

A task program describes its standard steps instead of running them. The compiler restores
the description, runs the steps and answers where each left its outputs.

Import as `Delegate` with `import silk.build.delegate as Delegate`.

Public declarations: 9.

<a id="submit"></a>

## `submit`

```silk
pub effect fn submit(description: &GraphDescription, directory: &Path) -> Outcome
  ! StepFailure
  ? &mut Allocator | &mut FileSystem | &mut HostInput
```

Hands a described graph to the compiler and reads its answer. The description and the answer
are files in `directory`, named by the description's contents, and removed afterwards.

### Errors
`StepError` with the compiler's report when the graph fails, or when the compiler cannot run.
